Dolly Parton, legendary country singer and songwriter, dies at 80
description: Born on January 19, 1946, in Tennessee, Parton grew up in a poor family and was one of 12 children. She began writing songs when she was about six years old. Her first known song, "Little Tiny Tasseltop", was about a corncob doll made with corn-silk hair. Parton was married to Carl Dean from 1966 until his death in 2025. He generally stayed away from the public spotlight.

title: 'Nation is not a dharamshala': Shah sets target for illegal immigration-free India
description: Home Minister Amit Shah has announced a strategic vision to rid India of illegal immigration in the near future. This initiative involves collaborating with border states through a four-pronged strategy aimed at bolstering security. The plan includes the participation of border forces, state administrations, central agencies, and local communities. Shah further highlighted the commitment to tackle terrorism and drug issues with proactive interventions, aiming for a developed nation by 2047.

title: 'Clear Class 10 together': Prashant Kishor's challenge to Bihar CM & Tejashwi
description: Prashant Kishor has thrown down the gauntlet to both Bihar's Chief Minister and opposition leader, challenging them to take their matriculation exams. He proposed that the education minister raise this topic at the upcoming cabinet meeting. This challenge follows the education minister's suggestion for Tejashwi Yadav to pass his exams. Kishor emphasized the need for leaders who inspire trust among the youth by demonstrating their academic capability.

title: Chad Ochocinco hints at Week 3 crossroads for Deshaun Watson's Browns future
description: Chad Ochocinco believes Deshaun Watson could lose his Browns starting job before Week 4 if Cleveland struggles early. Watson will start against Jacksonville, Tampa Bay and potentially Carolina, while Shedeur Sanders remains his backup. Ochocinco pointed to Week 3 as a possible turning point. Watson’s uneven preseason numbers have already added pressure before the regular season begins.

title: Cole Tucker, Vanessa Hudgens' combined net worth in 2026: MLB, Hollywood and more
description: Cole Tucker and Vanessa Hudgens have amassed wealth through very different careers. Tucker earned his from Major League Baseball, and Hudgens built up a long career in Hollywood. Their combined estimated net worth in 2026 is in the millions, considering Hudgens’ entertainment earnings, Tucker’s baseball income and their wider commercial and investment projects.

title: 9,000-year-old arrowheads covered in strange markings leave archaeologists puzzled
description: Unearthed from the depths of Turkey, ancient arrowheads reveal enigmatic hand-carved symbols. These Neolithic treasures showcase intentional incisions rather than random scratches, prompting researchers to ponder their origins. Despite thorough investigations, the specific purpose behind these markings remains unknown. Observations indicate that this intriguing practice was limited to select communities, leaving archaeologists grappling with unanswered questions about their significance.

title: Bengaluru clubs under FDA scanner, 10 flagged for violations
description: Food and Drugs Administration officials inspected ten prominent Bengaluru clubs on Tuesday.  Several clubs were found violating food safety and hygiene regulations.  Issues included unhygienic food handling and improper storage practices.  Label violations were also noted on food products found at one club.  These inspections are part of an ongoing drive to ensure compliance.

title: Sabalenka, Djokovic knocked out in first round of US Open mixed doubles
description: Aryna Sabalenka and Novak Djokovic were knocked out in the first round of the US Open mixed doubles after losing to doubles specialists Katerina Siniakova and Henry Patten 1-4, 4-2 (10-2). The top-seeded pair started strongly but failed to maintain their advantage. Patten and Siniakova advanced to the quarterfinals, while other stars including Serena Williams and Carlos Alcaraz also featured.

Her journey offers a potential path for transgender athletes in sports.

She articulated her disappointment over the vicious online discourse and called on the public to stop circulating the video, acknowledging the support she received during this ordeal.

His determination visibly rattled the Indian bowlers, and his adept use of the sweep shot proved crucial in countering spin. The resilience of the Sri Lankan lower order further thwarted India's attempts to secure victory.

title: ‘Jailed or killed’: How Iran is silencing citizens as internal tensions mount

This strategic decision is set to significantly enhance domestic industries, curtail reliance on imports, and elevate India’s capabilities in defence manufacturing, enabling the local production of guided weapon systems for military applications. Furthermore, this initiative will fortify the defence industrial landscape and encourage the involvement of MSMEs.

title: Crude awakening: As Russia, Iran face Trump heat, can Venezuela fill India’s oil gap?

description: Artificial intelligence is transforming the landscape of cyber warfare by automating intricate tasks. Recent reports depict AI agents taking charge of substantial segments of cyber operations, drastically cutting down the expertise and duration needed for traditional attack strategies. On the flip side, AI also equips cybersecurity professionals with enhanced capabilities to detect weaknesses. This ongoing battle depicts both sides racing to leverage AI innovations to outsmart each other.

title: Two hours, 500 metres: How Gurgaon’s rain stole my train
description: A commuter missed their train due to severe waterlogging and traffic jams.  The journey to New Delhi Railway Station became impossible after heavy rainfall began.  Roads remained choked for hours, preventing any significant travel progress.  This recurring infrastructure failure causes financial loss and disrupted plans for residents.  The city's response cycle repeats with every significant downpour.

title: Zuckerberg’s wife Priscilla Chan’s $125m school to shut after 10 yrs
description: The Primary School, a tuition-free institution for low-income families, has closed its doors after a decade. Funding from the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative ceased, prompting the board's unanimous decision to shut down. While offering extensive support services, the school's academic results did not meet state benchmarks. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative is providing financial support for the transition and educational savings accounts.
